lru_cache.py

A thread-safe LRU cache with per-entry TTL (time-to-live) expiry.

Features
--------
- Thread-safe via a re-entrant lock (RLock) so re-entrant calls are safe.
- LRU eviction when the cache exceeds its maximum size.
- Per-entry TTL: entries expire individually based on their own lifetime.
- Type hints throughout, generic over key/value types.
- Statistics: hits, misses, evictions, expiries.
- Usable as a decorator or as a standalone cache object.

Example
-------
    from lru_cache import LRUCache

    cache: LRUCache[str, int] = LRUCache(maxsize=128, default_ttl=60.0)
    cache.put("a", 1)
    cache.get("a")  # 1
